rows.summary: Typing that never pauses now repaints the preview at least every 1.2 s. It no longer freezes until typing stops, and it still runs one build at a time; the stale-render drop, zoom repaint, hidden-preview pause and Retry work as before. The store's saves stay coalesced (R2-077). They are written at once on pagehide, beforeunload, the tab being hidden, unmount, and now also when the list changes account (sign-out), so no edit is lost. A value set to what it holds already leaves the store as it was: nothing is written, built or synced. Another tab's save keeps the unchanged résumés as the same objects here, so the open résumé's preview is not rebuilt for nothing. Cloud sync reads the in-memory state, not storage, so it needs no flush.

extra.summary: A test now fails without f6cb390 and passes with it (failfirst f6cb390 ok in run 36088483415). It covers a 2-column Awards row split at Classic's page foot, where the right-hand award has no description and a long wrapping title. That is the only layout where react-pdf reads the keep f6cb390 changed. In one column, an award with no description moves with or without the fix.

A hidden end date (or start date) on an Education, Project or Volunteering entry, as a backup or older stored data can carry it, now prints nowhere. That holds for the preview/PDF in all 9 templates and for Word, as it already did for Markdown and ATS text. A current entry no longer prints 'Present' either. The root cause was the shared endDateOf, which ignored hiddenFields; a new startDateOf does the same for start dates. Entries with nothing hidden print as before. Failfirst f7057c2 ok in run 36089507566.
